name: Shy People
overview: Scripture acknowledges the struggles of those who feel timid or lacking in confidence, as Moses expressed his hesitation about speaking eloquently before God assured him of divine guidance (Exodus 4:10,12). Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, not fearing or being dismayed, because the Lord’s presence is constant and sustaining (Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10). Trusting in God rather than the fear of man brings safety and peace, as He upholds and strengthens those who fix their minds on Him (Proverbs 29:25; Isaiah 26:3).
